title: NetworkMachine
description: network.machine@1: one machine of a person, as the network's machines hub shows it (plan L34, steps M2 and M4). A machine is a Bot device of kind machine: an OpenVibe Node install that paired with the person's account. Bot stays the registry underneath (the device id is its dev_…); Network fronts it for the person and for apps the person consented. The roles are what the machine does for the network (the catalogue: network.machine-roles@1), and running is what it does right now. Nothing here is a secret: no credential, no hash, no address.

id.description: The machine's device id in Bot's registry (dev_…).

principal_id.description: The machine's node principal on Network (nod_…): the credential it holds. Absent for a machine Bot knows but Network has no principal for.

name.description: The name the owner gave it. Absent when they gave none.

kind.description: What the machine is, as Bot's device record says: onboard (the robot's own machine), bridge (a machine that drives a robot over the robot's own link), server (a machine that runs its owner's jobs).

os.description: The operating system the Node reports (linux, darwin, windows). Absent until the machine has checked in.

online.description: Whether the machine is connected to Bot right now.

last_seen_at.description: When the machine was last seen. Absent before its first check-in.

node_version.description: The OpenVibe Node version the machine reports. Absent until it has checked in.

roles.description: What the machine does for the network: the ids from the catalogue (network.machine-roles@1). The owner sets these; the machine applies them at its next check-in.

running.description: What the machine is doing right now, as a short list: its Codes jobs, its desks, the local models it serves and the robots it drives.

label.description: A short, plain description for the owner (the desk's name, the model's name).
